releaseNotes.zh: 启用全新对话餐碗 Logo，修复打字时顶部标识消失，改进语音权限与提示。语音转写需要设备支持。需要邀请码；请覆盖安装保留本地数据。
releaseNotes.en: New Table Talk logo, a stable header while typing, and clearer voice permissions and notices. Transcription requires device support. Invite required; install over the existing app to keep local data.
